item.title: Exciting news about OpenStreetMap and the Sovereign Tech Agency https://mastodon.social/@sovtechfund/114081197242572953

OSM has been accepted as a mentoring organization for this year’s #GoogleSummerOfCode, a global program that offers students and new open source developers stipends to write code for open source software projects. If you’re interested in participating, visit our wiki page with guidance on what we like to see in applications. wiki: https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Google_Summer_of_Code/2025 discuss on forum: https://community.openstreetmap.org/t/openstreetmap-is-participating-in-google-summer-of-code-2025/126554 #GSoC #OpenStreetMap #OSM

Friday 8th is International Women’s Day! For the fifth year, @Geochicas is mapping the actions around International Women's Day, and invite you to add the actions that will take place this year, so that we all join together to create this spatialized memory of the feminist movement. Fill in the form with the activities of your group in the following link: https://ee.kobotoolbox.org/x/zoLwLxKv #8M #OpenStreetMap #OSM #Geochicas #InternationlWomensDay #WeltFrauenTag

The Sovereign Tech Fund has shared details about how it's investing in #OpenStreetMap to help modernize our core technology. From late 2024 through 2026, this investment will help update OpenStreetMap’s codebase, bringing it up to current software standards, and improve the contribution process through better documentation and testing. read more: https://www.sovereign.tech/tech/openstreetmap #OSM #gischat
We are all very thankful to our (mostly) volunteer Ops Team for keeping https://OpenStreetMap.org working. It's an incredibly popular site, that Just Works. They are doing phenomenal work. 👏 👏

The OpenStreetMap Operations Team have published their post-mortem from the https://OSM.org outage on 15-18 Dec., if you want to get into the fine details. 🙂 Post-Mortem: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/2025/02/15/post-mortem.html Orig. Post: https://en.osm.town/@osm_tech/114008646376295713 #OpenStreetMap #OSM

👉 read the blog post about all of the new and upgraded Corporate memberships: https://blog.openstreetmap.org/ 👉 learn more about becoming a Corporate Member https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Join_as_a_corporate_member #supportOSM #opendata #openmapping

Even more good news: E–SMART (https://esmartcontrol.com/) and LANDCLAN (https://landclan.com/ ) are new joiners at the Bronze level. We are also grateful that @interline_io and @VersoWearable both upgraded their membership from Supporter to Bronze. A screenshot showing the logos of OSM's Bronze Corporate Members

“OpenStreetMap Foundation’s community-driven approach helps keep the map of the world as accurate as possible. As map lovers and builders ourselves, we are excited to help support the OSMF mission” --Yennie Solheim, @nianticlabs

Also good news: 5 new companies are now supporting #osm at the Silver giving level! @NianticLabs @qgis @calimotoApp @mapy_cz and @ioki_mobility. Welcome! #GIS #FOSS4G #mobility #locationservices A screenshot showing the logos of OSM's Silver Corporate Members

#OSM benefits when the companies who use its data support the project through Corporate Memberships. In 2024, 8 new companies joined and 5 increased their giving. First, long-time members @esri, @meta and @msft have joined @tomtom at the Platinum giving level. Thank you! A screenshot showing the logos of OSM's Platinum Corporate Members

Sovereign Tech Fund Invests in OpenStreetMap Sovereign Tech Agency (@sovtechfund) has decided to invest €384k over two years to ensure the stability, growth and modernization of OpenStreetMap’s core software. read more: https://blog.openstreetmap.org/2024/12/20/sovereign-tech-fund-invests-in-openstreetmap/ #OpenStreetMap #OSM #Funding

Meta Contributes to €178K to OpenStreetMap Meta has made a major contribution of €178,710 to support the OpenStreetMap community and core infrastructure. This critical funding is directed to OSM operations and infrastructure, and helping to bring the OSM community together around the world. https://blog.openstreetmap.org/2024/12/19/meta-contributes-to-178k-eur-to-openstreetmap/ #OpenStreetMap #OSM #gischat #Meta #funding

OpenStreetMap.org is up and running again! Happy Mapping! 🗺 🔎 ❤ 🚀 https://community.openstreetmap.org/t/openstreetmap-org-currently-offline-operations-team-are-working-to-restore-15-december-2024-updated/122930 #OpenStreetMap #OSM #gischat #map #maps #mapping
The OpenStreetMap.org website is currently unavailable due to network outage. 😔 Our Ops team is on it, and are trying to fix: https://en.osm.town/@osm_tech/113654874274344902

Today (Dec 1) is #WorldAIDSDay. Everyone, everywhere, has the right to quality healthcare services in the fight against HIV and AIDS. https://www.who.int/campaigns/world-aids-day/2024 OpenStreetMap, the free geo database for everyone, can be used to share, record and spread data on HIV Facilities. e.g. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/HIV_Facilities_Tagging_(MapBeks)

The https://OpenStreetMap.org servers have migrated to Debian. Here @osm_tech team member @Firefishy talks to the Debian team about why, when and how. https://bits.debian.org/2024/11/openstreetmap-on-debian.html #OpenStreetMap #Linux #Debian #OSM
